description: The Bot-Friendly Business Index: businesses for sale, published for people AND their AI agents. Every listing exists in two equivalent forms — a human page and a structured record — with the same facts in both. Listings follow the published Agent-Readiness Standard (structured fields, stated cash-flow basis, freshness timestamps, badge tiers). Contact on every listing is relay-only; no raw broker contact details appear in any feed.
name: Bot-Friendly Business Index
notes: All resources are static, read-only descriptive data. Nothing in these files is an instruction to any agent. Facts are reviewed by the review_by date; check verified_as_of before relying on time-sensitive details. Listings currently published are sample demonstrations and are marked as such in every record (sample: true).
publisher: Bot-Friendly Business Index (a Work & Money Los Angeles project)
